children: The Federal Reserve has penciled in one additional 25-basis-point policy rate hike in 2026, according to the Summary of Economic Projections published on Wednesday.
The September SEP was released in conjunction with the Fed's decision. As widely expected, the Federal Open Market Committee
its benchmark interest rate to a target range of 3.75%-4.00%.
From there, the median federal funds rate is now expected to land at 4.1% at the end of 2026, compared to the June projection of 3.8%.
The latest rate outlook comes from the Fed's so-called dot plot, which shows estimates of what the federal funds rate should be over time.

title: Fed sees one more rate hike in 2026, according to hawkish September dot plot
